raw_text:
PLAN "Prenatal Strength: 12-Week Programme (20-32 Weeks Pregnant)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build strength safely during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 20-24" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
